note: Privately owned RV/tent campground about 14 mi south of Sault Ste. Marie on S Mackinac Trail, with a sandy beach on Clear Lake. Directory listings (not the operator) describe about 80 sites, 20/30-amp electric with water at most, pull-thrus, a dump station and laundry, open mid-May to about October 1, with seasonals as well as nightly sites. No website of its own (Facebook only); phone from its Google listing. --Claude
summary: No operator website or booking engine: the website field is a Facebook page (unreadable), and searches find only directories (Campendium, RV Life, Roadtrippers, AllStays). Google Maps: 'Clear Lake Campground', 13301 Co Rd H63 (S Mackinac Trail), Dafter, 4.0 stars from 18 reviews, phone 906-635-0201 (matches). Cleared the directory-only hookups, site, facility, season-close and reservable values; note rewritten to say where those facts come from.
flags: Presence rule NOT met: Facebook page only (https://www.facebook.com/ClearLakeCamping/), no operator website or booking engine, and the Google Maps listing has only 18 reviews (4.0 stars, phone 906-635-0201, read 2026-10-22) - under the 25 the Google path needs.

No posted 2024+ rate from the operator; the price indicator is RV Life's $$ tier only (an RV Life reviewer reported $32/night in September 2024; Roadtrippers 'last nightly rate $30'). The note says it also sells seasonal sites; the seasonal share is unknown.
